## Description

Schema requires NAUO children to be `PRODUCT_DEFINITION`, but some files supply `PRODUCT_DEFINITION_SHAPE`. Schema-strict reader rejects.

## Reproducer recipe

`#5 = NEXT_ASSEMBLY_USAGE_OCCURRENCE(... #PDS_id ...)` where `#PDS_id` is a PDS, not a PD.

## Expected kernel behavior

heal — accept PDS child; resolve PDS → PD silently.
